args.title: Brightline Freight newsletter summary — Freight pricing this quarter
args.body:
- Newsletter (Freight pricing this quarter): points to the main article and a companion piece, the latter accessible via free email registration (registered with mei.novak@northwind.example per Mei's instruction).
- Main article: spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece: shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
